rows.text: INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE
TheNewHSKCourse1Workbook(hereinafterreferred toasthe
"Workbook")is a companion book for the New HSK Course 1 (hereinafter
referred to as the “Textbook"), serving to supplement, extend, and support the
contentoftheTextbook.
The “Study” component provides supplementary learning materials related to the
Textbook; the “Practice” component offers intensive exercises aligned with the
assessment exercises centered around theHSKexam.
Based on this framework, we have designed three major sections: "Xiaoyu's
Classroom", "Simulated Practice", and "Mock Test".
The“Xiaoyu's Classroom” section supplements knowledge of pronunciation
and Chinese characters, solidifying the foundation in speaking and writing.
Pronunciation content spans Lessons 1-15, while Chinese character content covers
Lessons 7-15.Teachers and learners mayuse these materials selectively as needed.
The “"Simulated Practice” section integrates HSK question types with post-
lesson assessments starting from Lesson 4. Combining practice with assessment,
itpresentsdiversequestion types and amoderatevolumeofexercises toevaluate
thelearningoutcomesofeachlesson.
The“Mock Test”sectionprovides a completeHSKLevel 1practice exam
upon the completion of all Level1 content,intended for comprehensive assessment.
TeachersandlearnersareadvisedtousethisWorkbookalongsidethe
Textbook to systematically coordinate teaching and learning progress.
TheWorkbook comeswithadigitaledition,accessiblevia theFLTRP
Global Smart Education Platform (https://global.unipus.cn). This platform offers
audio, video, interactive modules, and extra exercises. To activate your digital
edition,please scan the QR code located on the back cover.Additional teaching
andlearningresources canbeviewedanddownloadedfromFLTRPCLT
Resources (http://www.fltrp-clt.com).
